test_CountingIterator: test the CountingIterator to verify it counts items and supports skip and has_next methods
test_GroupedIterator: test the GroupedIterator to verify it groups items into batches of a specified size
test_ShardedIterator: test the ShardedIterator to verify it shards data across multiple workers by shard id
test_CountingIterator_take: test the CountingIterator take method to limit iteration to a specified number of items
test_BufferedIterator: test the BufferedIterator combined with CountingIterator to verify buffered iteration with take and skip
